name: OERA Woods Hole Station
reply: Woods Hole Station here. Aqua Nova, we read you five by five. Weather is fair and all is quiet ashore.

name: Nantucket Harbor Office
reply: Nantucket Harbor. Copy, Aqua Nova. Sea state two, no traffic concerns on your side.

name: Coast Guard Sector
reply: Coast Guard Sector. Aqua Nova, we have you on the plot. Keep this channel clear for calls and distress.

name: RV Gannet
reply: Gannet here. We are recovering a CTD cast. Nice to hear from the deep boat, Aqua Nova.

name: FV Marguerite
reply: Marguerite. Nets are out, Captain. Please keep clear below us.

name: DSV Meridian
reply: Meridian. We are on a survey line at depth. Good to hear a friendly voice, Aqua Nova.

name: OERA Operations
reply: OERA Operations. Captain, your traffic is logged. Check the inbox for orders.

name: Halcyon Research Station
reply: ...any station... this is Halcyon... power failing... we need help... please...
